title: Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
description: Without buyouts, Flock would "almost certainly" need to lay off staff.

title: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
description: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.

title: Google’s Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies
description: Google said Gemini had "acted appropriately" by ending each hack immediately.

title: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes
description: Petlibro's new Granary 2 smart feeders use a built-in scale and (on pricier models) an AI camera to track exactly how much your cat is eating and when — though the fanciest health-monitoring features will cost you an extra subscription.

title: AI safety conversations have gotten unbelievable
description: This week two conversations about AI safety went viral that demonstrate just how hard it is to discern AI fact from fiction.

title: Prices go up in 7 days. Get your Disrupt ticket now.
description: Current ticket pricing ends Sept. 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Join 10,000+ founders, investors and tech leaders at Disrupt and save up to $200 on your ticket until then..

title: Vals, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, is looking to become the gold standard for AI benchmarking
description: Vals AI is hoping to make AI benchmarking a more neutral and trustworthy resource in a world increasingly inundated by AI models.

title: India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos
description: Truecaller says the one-way sharing requirement would hand a commercially valuable proprietary asset to telecom operators.

title: Tilly Norwood’s press tour is going about as well as you’d expect for an AI
description: In one particularly odd interview, Norwood seems to malfunction and begin speaking Chinese.

title: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
description: UP.Labs, now doing business under the name Vantora, is building startups for industrial corporations.

title: Anthropic is operating a lab that conducts biology experiments
description: AI leaders have been promising that AI is the key to curing human disease. Anthropic researchers have also been warning that AI might kill us all.

title: AI hallucination nearly triggers US military operation
description: “It’s important for service members to understand the uncertainty inherent to LLMs," a GovAI research scholar warns.

title: Anthropic’s first embedded evaluator is … Accenture?
description: Accenture is about to take on its most high-risk consulting engagement ever.

title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
description: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.

title: A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
description: Jev, a new kind of AI model, is showing developers a cheaper and faster path to software intelligence.

title: Disney’s first CTO led an AI startup it once accused of copying its characters
description: The former CEO of Character.AI, which Disney previously sent a cease-and-desist letter to, will serve as the company's first-ever chief technology officer.

title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
description: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.

title: Dario Amodei and other AI leaders want to ‘Pace the Frontier’ but…how?
